svg.title: Smart Factory — production architecture
svg.desc: Factory equipment reaches a managed MQTT broker through Pi gateways or individual TLS devices. Oracle ARM64 hosts an application API role and one telemetry and notification worker. Vercel provides the web interface and API proxy; managed PostgreSQL, Redis, Resend and the Oracle BaSyx runtime provide data and asset services. OPC UA FX and TSN control and scheduling stay on the factory LAN.

g.text: Edge acquisition, managed messaging, private runtime roles and asset standards
TLS data access · OAuth asset gateway
